summary: Los Cabos mesmerizes visitors with dramatic desert landscapes colliding with azure Pacific waters, creating an unparalleled coastal paradise at the southern tip of the Baja California Peninsula. World-class resorts, championship golf courses, and vibrant nightlife blend seamlessly with authentic Mexican culture, fresh seafood, and outdoor adventures ranging from sport fishing to whale watching.

photography.goldenHourNotes: Golden hour in Los Cabos is exceptionally dramatic due to the desert landscape and coastal positioning. The hour before sunset provides warm light that beautifully illuminates El Arco and casts long shadows across desert terrain, while early morning light creates stunning reflections on calm ocean surfaces. Sunrise at Cerritos Beach or Cabo Pulmo offers softer, more directional light ideal for landscape photography with minimal harsh shadows.

weather.seasonality: Los Cabos experiences a warm, dry climate from November to April, making it ideal for outdoor activities and beach time. Summer months (June-September) bring intense heat and occasional tropical storms, while fall offers transitional weather with lower tourist crowds.
weather.summary: Los Cabos enjoys year-round sunshine with mild winters and hot summers, featuring distinctly dry and wet seasons. The region rarely experiences extreme weather, making it accessible for travel throughout the year.
